BAL-PubDoc-02 implemented against **bf0e9e3dac2f5bf42156acc4ddad85967a50e11d**, without commits or external publication.

Updated the complete review manuscript under `docs/publication/tracker-baseline-2026-10-29/`:

- Pixel and tracker-overview prose, baseline tables, wrappers/date and README.
- Current balanced snapshot, provenance and dedicated `scripts/balanced_snapshot.py`.
- Six geometry-dependent PDFs: pixel overview/barrels/routing/sector handoff and tracker layout/services.
- Explicit balanced modes in the three existing figure recipes.

Verified from canonical preliminary exports:

- **5,666 pixel modules; 12,410 patches; 280 endcap cooling circuits.**
- **46,250 tracker sensors; 54 signed logical groups.**
- All **3,050 barrel** and **1,308 positive-endcap module centres** agree with preserved local geometry and rigid placements.
- **30 imported controls** remain byte-identical, including strip chapters, six strip PDFs, strip table and unchanged pixel local-geometry assets.
- Python syntax and `git diff --check` pass.

The final producer check correctly detects that preliminary export fingerprints predate changes to `export.py`, `placements.py` and `trimmed_export.py`. `data/balanced-checks.json` explicitly records this pending source-freeze refresh. No checks were weakened.

After final canonical regeneration, rerun:

```sh
MPLCONFIGDIR=build/balanced-baseline/mpl-cache \
XDG_CACHE_HOME=build/balanced-baseline/cache \
build/truth-tracking-baseline/analysis-venv/bin/python -B \
docs/publication/tracker-baseline-2026-10-29/scripts/balanced_snapshot.py \
  --expected build/balanced-baseline/source-pixel/expected.json \
  --compact build/balanced-baseline/source-pixel/pixel-detector.xml \
  --materials build/balanced-baseline/source-pixel/materials.xml \
  --tracker-expected build/balanced-baseline/source-tracker/expected.json \
  --native FINAL_NATIVE_REPORT --render --check
```

`main.tex` is the full-report entrypoint. Final native provenance and PDF compilation/visual QA remain coordinator-owned.
